class Tokenizer:
    def __init__(self, source: str):
        self.source = source
        self.position = 0

    def next_token(self):
        while self.position < len(self.source):
            yield self.source[self.position]
            self.position += 1
```

class Tokenizer:

            self.position += 1

```python
class Tokenizer:
    def __init__(self, source: str):
        self.source = source
        self.position = 0

    def next_token(self):
        while self.position < len(self.source):
            yield self.source[self.position]
            self.position += 1
```

```python
class Tokenizer:
    def __init__(self, source: str):
        self.source = source
        self.position = 0

    def next_token(self):
        while self.position < len(self.source):
            yield self.source[self.position]
            self.position += 1
```

```python
class Tokenizer:
    def __init__(self, source: str):
        self.source = source
        self.position = 0

    def next_token(self):
        while self.position < len(self.source):
            yield self.source[self.position]
            self.position += 1
```

```python
class Tokenizer:
    def __init__(self, source: str):
        self.source = source
        self.position = 0

    def next_token(self):
        while self.position < len(self.source):
            yield self.source[self.position]
            self.position += 1
```

class Tokenizer:
    def __init__(self, source: str):
        self.source = source
        self.position = 0

    def next_token(self):
        while self.position < len(self.source):
            yield self.source[self.position]
            self.position += 1
```

```python
class Tokenizer:
    def __init__(self, source: str):
        self.source = source
        self.position = 0

    def next_token(self):
        while self.position < len(self.source):
            yield self.source[self.position]
            self.position += 1
```

class Tokenizer:
    def __init__(self, source: str):
        self.source = source
        self.position = 0

    def next_token(self):
        while self.position < len(self.source):
            yield self.source[self.position]
            self.position += 1
```
